facts.value: Temperate maritime: avg 2.9 °C in Jan, 18.1 °C in Jul; ~868 mm rain/yr; ~1644 h sun/yr (KNMI 1991-2020, Deelen)
facts.notes: No KNMI station in Wageningen; Deelen (near Arnhem) is about 20 km away.

facts.value: Statutory minimum from 1 Jul 2026: € 14.99/h gross at 21+; € 11.99 (age 20), € 8.99 (19), € 7.50 (18). Same nationwide.
